title: Positive Labour Market Impact Assessments now valid for 6 months, not 12
body: A positive Labour Market Impact Assessment issued on an application received on or after 1 May 2024 is valid for a maximum of 6 months from the date it is issued, down from the previous 12-month validity period. The named worker must apply for their work permit inside that 6-month window; an expired assessment cannot be extended, and an employer whose worker misses the window generally has to start the LMIA process again from the beginning, including the fee.
